group.label: Edit UI
group.description: Inline-edit anything on the screen. With Edit UI on, hold Ctrl (long-press on a phone) and click the thing to edit it; let go of Ctrl to stop. Every edit saves where that value lives (the look, a data source) and can be undone with Ctrl+Z.

settings.label: Edit UI
settings.description: On: hold Ctrl and click anything to edit it inline. Off: Ctrl does nothing.
